product_one_liner.value: iVoyant’s Koodisi connects business systems through no-code workflow automation and built-in API management for enterprise and mid-market IT and integration teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The product overview identifies Koodisi as an Ivoyant LLC product, describes its no-code integration and API-management capabilities, and names enterprise/mid-market organizations and IT/integration teams as its audience: https://koodisi.com/what-is-koodisi.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes an enterprise plan and its inclusions, although pricing is quoted rather than published numerically: https://koodisi.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: iVoyant names PODS, UPS and NAPA Auto Parts in its past-performance examples, rather than as investors or partners: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement. | named_customers.0: PODS is named in iVoyant’s past-performance examples: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement. | named_customers.1: UPS is named in iVoyant’s past-performance examples: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement. | named_customers.2: NAPA Auto Parts is named in iVoyant’s past-performance examples: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement.

employee_band.notes: A September 2026 numerical headcount of approximately 81 places iVoyant in the 51–100 band: https://leadiq.com/c/ivoyant/5c54a9d921000027af661378/employee-directory. This is preferred over the conflicting, broader company-profile size category.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Ivoyant about page explicitly labels its Atlanta address as headquarters: https://koodisi.com/about. | hq_country: The headquarters address explicitly identifies the United States: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/ivoyant.

founded_year.notes: iVoyant’s company profile explicitly lists 2014 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/ivoyant-llc.

eng_blog.notes: The mixed company blog contains at least two engineer-authored implementation accounts: Ayush Sharma explains LLM-based routing inside PlatformNX’s co-pilot, and Carlos Gutierrez describes mock-API construction and refactoring for a project being built with iVoyant. Sources: https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs/text-classification-with-llms-powering-intelligent-user-content-routing-in-enterprises and https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs/struggling-forward-cursor-mock-apis-and-the-weight-of-self-doubt. Their engineering roles are supported by https://neuron.com/profile/5962800669/ayush-sharma and https://linkedin.com/in/cargdev. Classification requires judgment because the blog also contains marketing and personal-development material.

public_docs.notes: A publicly accessible documentation portal contains multiple distinct guides, including workflow creation, use cases and Git-based development: https://docs.koodisi.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists an AI/ML Engineer vacancy with an application page: https://boards.greenhouse.io/ivoyant/jobs/5257928004.

model_provider.notes: Koodisi’s documentation explicitly states that its OpenAI activities call the OpenAI REST API and return responses to workflows: https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai. This establishes an available product integration, not necessarily the provider behind every internal AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: iVoyant publicly states that it is now SOC 2 Type II certified on its corporate page: https://linkedin.com/company/ivoyant-llc. This completed corporate claim is distinct from Koodisi’s security page, which describes certificates awaiting issuance; pending certifications were not added. | compliance_certs.0: The company explicitly claims completed SOC 2 Type II certification: https://linkedin.com/company/ivoyant-llc.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is recorded as having no funding rounds, supporting no outside funding raised during the requested 18-month window: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/ivoyant/__GHS4A09BBZYQHq0c5ZqR43d-kAgP44kGTKVEWSoDWgo.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists AI/ML, frontend, full-stack lead, test-engineering and UX roles, but no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening: https://boards.greenhouse.io/ivoyant.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying new-product or major-feature launch was identified in the readable history for the requested six-month window. The recent blog index contains educational and comparison posts; the July 2 MCP post explains access to existing APIs, rather than announcing a new release. The Engage feature overview is dated April 6, before the window. Sources: https://koodisi.com/blog, https://koodisi.com/blog/expose-your-apis-to-agents-without-losing-control and https://koodisi.com/blog/integration-monitoring-vs-recovery-layer. This is a limited negative based on the available publication history.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The official team page was reviewed, but it does not supply appointment dates, and additional executive profiles did not establish a qualifying dated join or departure. An absence of announcements was not treated as proof of no turnover. Team page: https://www.ivoyant.com/about-us.
